messages.issues.skill.issues-capture.name: Record and manage personal issues
messages.issues.skill.issues-capture.description: Use when the user asks to record, view, edit, or delete a personal issue. Record only issues the user raises without diagnosing causes or proposing fixes.
messages.issues.skill.issues-capture.when-to-use: The user explicitly wants to save an issue or view, edit, or delete a recorded personal issue.
messages.issues.skill.issues-capture.when-not-to-: Don’t use for diagnosis, repairs, solution writing, an unrequested record, or shared team tickets.
messages.issues.agent-prompt.issues-name.title: Name an Issue
messages.issues.agent-prompt.issues-name.purpose: Create a title and classify the Issue from the user’s description and screenshots; ask one question if the evidence is insufficient
messages.issues.help.title: Issues
messages.issues.help.what: Quickly capture bugs, rough edges, or follow-up items with optional screenshots so nothing slips through the cracks.
messages.issues.help.example-1: Open a quick note, describe what happened, and attach a screenshot
messages.issues.help.example-2: Filter open items in your list and mark them resolved once handled
messages.issues.help.scope: Saved locally in the current space (your personal space, or a project that has it on) — never sent to an external server automatically.
messages.issues.help.advanced: Paste or drop screenshots directly; deleting an item asks for confirmation first.
messages.issues.permission.issues-write.reason: Record, edit, and delete your personal issues
messages.issues.permission.storage-private.reason: Save your issues locally in your personal space
messages.issues.permission.model-invoke.reason: Suggest a title and type when you capture or organize an issue
messages.issues.actions.prepare.title: Prepare issue draft
messages.issues.actions.prepare.description: Prepares an issue draft in the current space, keeping your exact wording and screenshots.
messages.issues.actions.cancel-capture.title: Cancel issue draft
messages.issues.actions.cancel-capture.descriptio: Discards an unsaved issue draft and clears its temporary screenshots.
messages.issues.actions.name-draft.title: Organize and save captured issue
messages.issues.actions.name-draft.description: Uses your active text model to suggest a concise title and type, then saves the issue. If details aren’t enough, it asks one follow-up question instead of saving.
messages.issues.actions.suggest-name.title: Suggest title and type
messages.issues.actions.suggest-name.description: Uses your active text model to suggest a title and type from your draft text and screenshots without saving.
messages.issues.actions.capture.title: Save captured issue
messages.issues.actions.capture.description: Saves the prepared draft as an issue, keeping your original wording and follow-up answers. Newly saved records can be undone.
messages.issues.actions.discard.title: Undo recorded issue
messages.issues.actions.discard.description: Removes a newly saved issue only if it hasn’t been edited since saving; otherwise keeps it and explains why.
messages.issues.actions.list.title: List issues
messages.issues.actions.list.description: Lists the issues you recorded in the current space.
messages.issues.actions.read.title: Read issue details
messages.issues.actions.read.description: Reads a personal issue’s full description, follow-up answers, screenshots, and current version.
messages.issues.actions.create.title: Create issue
messages.issues.actions.create.description: Creates a personal issue keeping your original wording, typed as a bug, experience issue, or feature request.
messages.issues.actions.update.title: Update issue
messages.issues.actions.update.description: Updates an issue’s title, description, type, or screenshots against its current version without overwriting newer edits.
messages.issues.actions.delete.title: Delete issue
messages.issues.actions.delete.description: Permanently deletes a personal issue against its current version.
